name: field-loaded
description: #38: after the title has accepted a save, wait until the game is in field mode (g_GameState 1, confirmed #76) and the field has loaded: g_IsFieldLoading (confirmed #77) leaves 2 and then reads 2 again (#77's rule; at the title it reads 0).
